title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2's New Promo Video Teases Next Arc
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Fujino Ōmori and Toshi Aoi 's Wistoria: Wand and Sword ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) manga streamed the promotional video for its new arc on Sunday. The arc will start in the season's sixth episode (18th episode overall), on May 17.
author: ANN

title: Nagisa Furuya's The Summer of You Boys-Love Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: TV Tokyo revealed on Saturday that Nagisa Furuya 's The Summer of You boys love manga will get a live-action series adaptation. The series will exclusively stream in advance on the U-NEXT streaming service in Japan from June 24, and the series will debut on TV Tokyo 's "Drama NEXT" programming block on July 1.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Lists Akane-banashi Anime's English Dub Cast, Staff Members
content: Netflix has listed the English dub cast and staff members for the first two episodes of the anime of writer Yūki Suenaga and illustrator Takamasa Moue 's Akane-banashi manga. title: New One Piece Game Adapts A Major Action Packed Storyline
content: It’s a great time to be a One Piece fan, and between the continuing live-action Netflix series , the One Piece anime remake, the One Piece TCG, and the upcoming One Piece: Dawn of Liberation , fans will have no shortage of things to jump into from the franchise.

title: Netflix’s One Piece Remake Has Exciting Update For Fans in June
content: As one of the longest-running series of all time, One Piece is known for a vast and expansive world with countless characters. The story only keeps getting better as it continues, while exploring the layers of mysteries surrounding the characters and the forgotten past.

title: 3 Major Questions Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo Never Answered
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Jujutsu Kaisen manga! Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo shocked fans with the tragic fate that befell Yuji Itadori, the protagonist of the original series. The main story ended in September 2024, and only a year later, the series returned with a sequel story.

title: Tubi Adds Magical Sisters LuluttoLilly Anime
content: The Tubi streaming service is streaming the first three episodes of Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), Bandai Namco Filmworks ' new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot . The series is available with Japanese audio and English subtitles.
author: ANN

title: Major Shonen Jump Reboot Is Officially Streaming on Netflix After a Year
content: Weekly Shonen Jump’s beloved manga Hell Teacher Nube is getting an anime reboot after nearly three decades. The manga debuted in 1993 and continued till 1999. The series is still loved by many for blending supernatural horror with humor and having several heartfelt moments.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Announces 2 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga announced two more cast members on Friday and Saturday. Sōshō Tomimoto plays Ikki Niko of Te am Y. Keisuke Kida plays Hibiki Ohkawa.
